RR 

On 25 July 2016, Lieutenant Colonel Atul Gupta of 30 RASHTRIYA RIFLES led his troops to intercept a group of terrorists in Kupwara, J&K. He then engaged them effectively, eliminating two terrorists singlehandedly. He was awarded the Shaurya Chakra.

(PS: Please ignore stars on shoulder and collar tabs)
comment: Beyond the act of courage itself, such operations highlight the importance of intelligence, team coordination, and split-second decision-making that shape outcomes in high-risk environments.
